name: fix123_cave_roof_hero

notes: Owner workaround in a demo/dev build (F10 console): 'unstuck' (this fix), or 'tp pos=x,z' (two numbers: the topmost ground there), or 'tp spot=faring_start'. Log lines: '[G3Player] fix-123 standing: on a ceiling top inside the rock ... moved', 'fix-123 load: ...', '[G3Player] out of the world ... (last safe position)', 'fix-123: no lift onto ... (a ceiling over him ...)'. The save on the roof may come after the guard already took the hero down (it judges every 0.4 s, twice); then the load step only checks that the loaded pose is a floor.
